nodes.name: Context / Current World / Intent / Task / Safety Need
nodes.producer: Context Foundation, Field State, Intent Governance, Task Manager, Safety/Permission
nodes.gap: No single product-cycle input envelope joins all demand sources.

nodes.name: Information Need
nodes.producer: Field Perception Orchestrator information-gap detector; observation planning dryrun
nodes.gap: Need candidate is not admitted into a route-level demand lifecycle.

nodes.name: Observation Demand
nodes.gap: Demand is visual/task-oriented and lacks canonical cross-modal route handoff.

nodes.name: Observation Request
nodes.producer: Task Observation Request contract; observation_manager request classifier
nodes.gap: Contracts are distributed and some are legacy or controlled-only.

nodes.name: Attention Target
nodes.producer: Attention candidate types; observation_manager attention coordinator; region planner
nodes.gap: No live bounded target selection or redirect loop is proven.

nodes.name: Capability Requirement
nodes.producer: Field Perception capability planner and model requirement adapter
nodes.gap: Requirement-to-admission handoff is not a product runtime gate.

nodes.name: Capability Selection
nodes.producer: Capability Registry and Model Manager capability matcher
nodes.gap: Registry/admission/availability are distinct but not closed into an observation control session.

nodes.name: Model / Provider Routing
nodes.producer: Model Manager routing candidate and fallback planner
nodes.gap: Provider candidate selection is not equivalent to invocation admission.

nodes.name: Provider Execution Boundary
nodes.producer: Model/Capability Admission and Runtime Executor contracts
nodes.gap: No A Route product runtime start/stop admission is proven.

nodes.name: Perception Evidence
nodes.producer: Vision/OCR/SLAM adapters and provider evidence contracts
nodes.gap: Real provider output is not connected; provider source selection remains separate.

nodes.name: Observation Gateway
nodes.gap: 22/22 controlled verification proves candidate ingress, not demand authorization or runtime continuation.

nodes.name: Canonical Observation
nodes.producer: Observation Gateway and observation_manager candidate builders
nodes.gap: Admitted observation is structurally admissible, not a fact or a stop decision.

nodes.name: Evidence Sufficiency
nodes.producer: Field Perception sufficiency input and observation_manager evidence quality candidate

nodes.name: Continue / Redirect / Switch / Stop
nodes.producer: Field Perception stop/re-observation policy; Model Manager fallback; Cognitive Flow reconsideration
nodes.consumer: Next observation demand or A Route cycle
nodes.gap: Policies are candidates; no unified bounded control loop or runtime revocation.

nodes.name: Next Cognitive Cycle
nodes.consumer: Context, Intent, Task and Active Observation Control
nodes.gap: Observation feedback is not a product-ready next-cycle demand path.
